purpose: Qualify the compact model-visible causal frontier before any new development case or paired effectiveness claim.
claim_scope: Consumed-case measurement and mechanism integrity only; no effectiveness, held-out, generalization, significance, or leaderboard claim.
changes_since_v2: Project the full internal frontier into a budgeted structure that always retains causal_roots and summary fields instead of truncating the entire object.
Prioritize causal roots over descriptive environment facts inside the projection budget.
Evaluate tuple comparisons against sys.version_info so inactive compatibility imports do not become false obligations.
non_changes: No closed operation vocabulary or action blocking was added.
Raw evidence, the full internal frontier, verifier hierarchy, candidate retention, and official evaluator boundary are unchanged.
The Python guard correction is shared solver infrastructure and will apply to both conditions in the later paired experiment.

cases.source: The same three already-consumed P5 V2 mechanism cases; no fresh Dev case is consumed.

execution.execution_mode: single sequential lane to avoid the dependency-download contention observed in V2
execution.token_policy: Token and price are reported outcomes; configured limits are emergency guards rather than research stopping thresholds.
execution.official_evaluator_access: post-episode-only; official outcomes are diagnostic and are not part of this integrity gate

measurement_integrity_gate: Every proposed action persists the exact model-visible frontier with a valid canonical digest.
Every persisted frontier is an object containing causal_roots as a list and summary as an object.
No decision omits a causal root because of the projection budget.
Every episode reaches an identity-matched terminal official evaluation or is archived as infrastructure-censored.
diagnostics_not_used_for_the_gate: which target roots arise under stochastic model actions
token count, elapsed time, and reported price
proceed_rule: Freeze a paired multi-block V3 effectiveness experiment on the same consumed cases only if all non-infrastructure-censored episodes pass the projection gate; do not consume a fresh Dev case at this stage.
failure_rule: Archive failures and perform measurement-only diagnosis. Do not reinterpret V2 outcomes or tune against fresh Dev or official evaluator feedback.
